displayContract.byline: Assessments made by 5.6 Sol. — Rubric: Slugfester Reassessment Rubric v2.

thesis.text: Theism gains comparative support if one integrated personal foundation can nonnecessitatingly ground contingent reality while also making calibrated religious awareness and culturally mediated relationship more expected than they are under naturalism.

novelty.explanation: This steelman integrates Pearce's separate metaphysical and experiential routes while narrowing their claims in response to the strongest naturalistic objections.

premises.text: A satisfactory comparison should reward not merely the availability of separate explanations but also explanatory integration across contingency, consciousness, normativity, religious awareness, and interpersonal significance.

novelty.explanation: This develops the transcript's local-advantage method into an explicit integration criterion for comparing complete worldviews.

premises.text: Divine freedom should be offered as a model of nonnecessitating determination only after theism explains how reasons can guide creation without causally compelling one uniquely necessary history.

novelty.explanation: This repairs the unsupported explanatory demand by stating what the divine-freedom model must add beyond Oppy's indeterministic countermodel.

premises.text: An essence-based terminus has comparative value only if a substantive account of perfect agency constrains the divine nature more tightly than a merely nominated natural initial state.

novelty.explanation: This directly addresses the symmetry objection by requiring differentiating content rather than relying upon the existence of a traditional divine candidate.

premises.text: Religious experience should contribute through a calibrated cumulative case using cross-context coherence, durable moral transformation, resistance to expectation, and responsible testimonial transmission rather than intensity alone.

novelty.explanation: This adds independent reliability criteria to repair the transcript's incomplete account of experiential quality and defeaters.

premises.text: Religious diversity is compatible with divine relationship only if theism states limited communicative aims and identifies observable patterns that cultural mediation predicts without making every possible distribution equally expected.

novelty.explanation: This constrains the holistic-purpose reply so that it becomes testable against communicative disorder and naturalistic cultural explanations.

conclusion.text: If the personal-grounding model supplies genuine integration, survives symmetry, and supports independently calibrated experiential expectations, theism receives a meaningful but defeasible overall explanatory advantage over naturalism.

novelty.explanation: The conclusion proportionately conditions theism's advantage on completing the principal tasks left unresolved in the participant's case.

newArguments.title: Cross-domain compression
newArguments.text: A personal ground could earn comparative value through cross-domain compression rather than by filling a single unexplained gap. If the same constrained account of perfect agency helps explain why contingent reality exists, why rational creatures can recognize reasons, and why interpersonal or religious awareness arises, its cost is not simply one extra entity repeated across several arguments. The relevant test is whether the shared structure yields independent expectations and fewer disconnected primitives than the best naturalistic package. This argument succeeds only if those expectations are stated beforehand and cannot be recreated equally well by unrelated natural mechanisms.

novelty.explanation: This is a new unification argument based on cross-domain compression, not a restatement of any locked transcript move.

newArguments.title: Costly counterexpectational experience
newArguments.text: Religious evidence could be filtered for experiences that are costly, resistant to prior expectation, stable under reflection, and productive of specific long-term changes not easily explained by conformity or immediate reward. Such cases would not automatically verify their theological interpretation, but they could receive more weight than raw prevalence or subjective intensity. Comparing these markers across traditions would also expose rather than conceal disagreement. Theism would gain support only if the selected pattern is more expected under limited divine relational aims than under independently specified psychological and social mechanisms.

novelty.explanation: This supplies operational quality criteria and a comparative test that the participant's first-person argument did not fully provide.

thesis.text: Naturalism is comparatively preferable when natural foundational models match theism's metaphysical possibilities and independently grounded cognitive, cultural, and historical mechanisms better predict the distribution of religious belief and experience.

novelty.explanation: This steelman turns the programmatic naturalistic thesis into a conditional comparison tied to specified metaphysical and religious explanatory tasks.

premises.text: Comparative judgment should use shared criteria including explanatory scope, predictive constraint, integration, ontological commitment, and sensitivity to evidence rather than treating simplicity or coverage as self-interpreting virtues.

novelty.explanation: This repairs the transcript's undeveloped aggregation method by supplying common criteria that preserve reasonable judgment without making it arbitrary.

premises.text: A necessary natural foundation with indeterministic development is a legitimate modal countermodel, although naturalism should distinguish demonstrating coherence from providing a complete explanation of why that structure obtains.

novelty.explanation: This preserves Oppy's strongest countermodel while explicitly limiting what its conceptual availability establishes.

premises.text: No essence-based stopping rule favors God unless independently warranted divine content explains necessity more successfully than an equally constrained account of fundamental natural reality.

novelty.explanation: This develops the symmetry challenge into a comparative demand for independently warranted and equally constrained candidate descriptions.

premises.text: Religious experiences require calibration using mechanisms, base conditions, cross-tradition disagreement, situational reliability, and differences between confidence that an experience occurred and confidence in its supernatural interpretation.

novelty.explanation: This extends the transcript's calibration case by separating phenomenological occurrence from ontological interpretation and identifying additional evidential controls.

premises.text: Naturalism gains comparative support if independently evidenced learning, agency detection, prestige transmission, institutional selection, and historical isolation jointly predict both recurring religious themes and durable doctrinal divergence.

novelty.explanation: This repairs the compressed positive mechanism behind Oppy's claim that naturalism more easily explains religious diversity.

conclusion.text: If these mechanisms predict the evidence with greater constraint while theistic grounding and communication remain symmetrically available but weakly differentiated, naturalism earns a defeasible comparative advantage.

novelty.explanation: The conclusion proportionately conditions naturalism's advantage on predictive performance and continued failure of theism to establish differentiating resources.

newArguments.title: Mechanism portability test
newArguments.text: Naturalistic explanations should be tested for portability beyond religion. If ordinary mechanisms such as agency detection, memory reconstruction, prestige learning, coalition signaling, and institutional selection already explain comparable patterns in political, moral, paranormal, and ideological belief, applying them to religion gains independent support. Portability reduces the danger of inventing a mechanism solely to dismiss religious evidence. The comparison should still examine residual features that these mechanisms fail to predict. Naturalism gains ground only where independently evidenced processes forecast both common experiential structures and culturally variable interpretations without ad hoc adjustment.

novelty.explanation: This new argument supports naturalism through independently testable portability across multiple belief domains.

newArguments.title: Asymmetric prediction ledger
newArguments.text: The worldviews can be compared through a preregistered ledger of divergent expectations: the frequency of unsolicited experiences, their dependence on training, rates of doctrinal convergence, correction after contradictory revelation, geographic inheritance, and persistence under social disruption. Neither worldview should receive credit merely for accommodating results afterward. A naturalistic package gains support where established mechanisms assign the observed patterns higher prior likelihood than a specified relational-divine model. Conversely, convergence or reliable novel information could count against that package. This framework converts communicative disorder from an intuitive complaint into a balanced program of discriminating comparisons.

novelty.explanation: This repairs the communicative-disorder argument by supplying symmetrical, potentially disconfirming predictions for both worldviews.
